title: Mission step enhancement
description: The additions a step enhancement contributes (missions/<type>/enhancements/<id>.step-enhancement.yaml). Its target is not a field: the enhancing pack's graph documents carry the only enhances edge, to action:<type>/<step> (ADR-0053 decision 22; ADR-0064). prompt_fragments names one Markdown companion per slot of that step's prompt (ADR-0066): one companion per entry, any stem matching the pattern, each named by exactly one entry. This schema refuses an id that breaks its pattern, a slot that breaks <namespace>:<name> and prompt_fragments: [] (minItems), and the store's stem rule refuses an id that differs from its file stem as a schema violation too. Semantic checks beside the schema refuse with prompt_fragment_invalid, naming the file: a slot that occurs twice, a companion that is missing, shared by two entries or named by none (an orphan), a fragment that is blank, has frontmatter, a carriage return or a byte order mark, or holds a slot marker or an unclosed comment, an enhancement without exactly one enhances edge to an action:<type>/<step>, with an overrides edge (an enhancement only adds), whose <type> directory differs from that edge's type, whose id repeats across type directories (the second file is refused and withheld from the pack) or with an absent prompt_fragments key. The guard and emit additions of ADR-0053 decision 22 are fields, add_guards, add_lifecycle_guards and emits, built under #434; they are not edges and not in this shape yet.

schema_version.description: The step-enhancement shape's version, the string "1.0".
schema_version.title: Schema Version

id.description: The enhancement's stable identity; equal to its file stem.
id.title: Id

prompt_fragments.description: Markdown companions to insert into named slots of the enhanced step's prompt, one companion per entry. An empty list is refused by this schema (minItems); an absent key is refused by a semantic check as prompt_fragment_invalid, since an enhancement adds nothing without an entry. Each slot id occurs at most once. No target, range, anchor, position or priority field exists (ADR-0066 decisions 3, 5 and 7).

slot.description: The slot declared by the prompt in force for the enhanced step: <namespace>:<name>, each part lower-case and starting with a letter.
slot.title: Slot

path.description: The Markdown companion beside this enhancement file: one companion per entry, any stem matching the pattern, each named by exactly one entry; no subdirectory or other file form.
path.title: Path
